meta.title: Knowledge base
meta.description: An article is drafted from a resolved ticket, reviewed by a second agent and published in the help center, where customers find it through search.

notes: Generic example sub-flow, opened by clicking the knowledge base in support-ticket.json. Its lenses do not match the parent's, so it opens in its own default.
